<?php

class FastReader {
    private $data = [];
    private $index = 0;

    public function __construct() {
        $input = '';
        while (!feof(STDIN)) {
            $line = fgets(STDIN);
            if ($line === false) break;
            $input .= $line . ' ';
        }
        $this->data = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($input));
    }

    public function next() {
        if ($this->index >= count($this->data)) {
            return null;
        }
        return $this->data[$this->index++];
    }

    public function nextInt() {
        return intval($this->next());
    }

    public function nextLong() {
        return intval($this->next());
    }

    public function nextDouble() {
        return floatval($this->next());
    }

    public function nextLine() {
        return trim(fgets(STDIN));
    }

    public function readIntArray($n) {
        $a = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $a[$i] = $this->nextInt();
        }
        return $a;
    }

    public function readLongArray($n) {
        $a = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $a[$i] = $this->nextLong();
        }
        return $a;
    }

    public function readDoubleArray($n) {
        $a = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $a[$i] = $this->nextDouble();
        }
        return $a;
    }
}

$fs = new FastReader();
$n = $fs->nextLong();
$k = $fs->nextLong();
$set = [];
$bool = true;

for ($i = 1; $i <= $k; $i++) {
    $rest = $n % $i;
    if (!array_key_exists($rest, $set)) {
        $set[$rest] = true;
    } else {
        $bool = false;
        break;
    }
}

if ($bool) {
    echo "Yes\n";
} else {
    echo "No\n";
}

source_data.prob_desc_description: Imp is watching a documentary about cave painting.  Some numbers, carved in chaotic order, immediately attracted his attention. Imp rapidly proposed a guess that they are the remainders of division of a number n by all integers i from 1 to k. Unfortunately, there are too many integers to analyze for Imp.Imp wants you to check whether all these remainders are distinct. Formally, he wants to check, if all , 1 ≤ i ≤ k, are distinct, i. e. there is no such pair (i, j) that:   1 ≤ i < j ≤ k,  , where  is the remainder of division x by y.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print "Yes", if all the remainders are distinct, and "No" otherwise. You can print each letter in arbitrary case (lower or upper).
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The only line contains two integers n, k (1 ≤ n, k ≤ 1018).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first sample remainders modulo 1 and 4 coincide.
